responsibility: This file provides the stock implementations of GCC’s generic hook helpers: reusable no-op procedures, constant true/false predicates, zero/one integer returners, null-returning accessors, identity mappings, and a few tiny policy defaults such as thunk-emission predicates. Its role is to supply type-correct fallback functions that can be plugged into target, language, or host hook tables from hooks.h and the various *_def headers, avoiding duplicated boilerplate when a hook slot needs a trivial default behavior.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line stock hook function bodies referenced from gcc/hooks.h—no-op, constant-returning, null-returning, and identity defaults—whereas the header is only the prototype catalog used when building hook tables.
